headline: Millbrook looks like a standard GTD Concrete CMS plus PATCHS site for appointments, but its prescriptions page is more restrictive than many of the others: it explicitly says repeat prescription requests are handled through NHS account or the online request form, not by phone or email.

Search and NHS-profile checks did not surface a separate live practice domain; this GTD URL appears to be the patient-facing microsite.

probably_true: PATCHS is the current patient-facing request platform here.
Millbrook is one of the clearer GTD sites on shutting down phone and email as prescription request channels.
needs_follow_up: Whether the prominent patient letter about proposed changes at the practice materially changes access beyond what the current route pages describe.
